utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Good afternoon to everybody in the courtroom. I see you're on your feet, Mr. McCloskey.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, good afternoon, Mr. President, Your Honours, everyone. Just I have some translations uploaded now, just four exhibits that I can read out, and if you would like.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: P2222. The next one is P2228. The third is P2234. And, lastly, P2251.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. This morning we received the response of the Defence to the motion of the Prosecution, in relation to 98 bis. I would like to ask you, Mr. McCloskey, if you intend to reply.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. I have spoken with Mr. Thayer and Mr. Vanderpuye about it. I would like to have a chance to discuss a bit with Mr. Gajic. But we should be able to get out a brief reply fairly quickly, I think.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Can you please be a bit more specific? "Fairly quickly" can be everything.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: We are okay with that, and we are looking forward to receive your reply by Tuesday next week.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you. We'll continue to discuss things, if we can work anything out. There are some interesting ideas and issues. And if we can work something out, we'll get back to you sooner than that, but we'll do our best.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: If there are no other matters to discuss before the witness is brought in, then we have to move into closed session because we are hearing a witness with protective measures. That means, in this specific case, closed session. We move into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're back in open session, Your Honours. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: During today's session, we have heard a protected witness in closed session. We adjourn now, and we will resume on Monday, 2.15 in the afternoon, in Courtroom III. We adjourn.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 20th day of June, 2011, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 7.00 p.m.,
